faqs.q: What is in the KFC Famous Bowl?
faqs.a: The KFC Famous Bowl layers mashed potatoes, sweet corn, bite-sized crispy chicken and gravy, topped with a three-cheese blend. The classic bowl is around $5.00, or about $7.99 as a combo with a side and drink.

faqs.q: How much is a bucket of chicken at KFC?
faqs.a: An 8 piece chicken meal is around $24.99, a 12 piece is about $36.99, and a 16 piece is about $56.99. These come with sides and biscuits. Prices vary by location.
Saucy by KFC is KFC's sauce-forward lineup, built around saucy nuggets and saucy chicken sandwiches in flavors like Nashville Hot and Korean BBQ. An 8 piece of saucy nuggets starts around $5.00.
Yes. KFC Popcorn Chicken is available as an individual portion for around $5.49, a large for about $7.99, or as a combo near $8.99. Availability can vary by location.
KFC runs a rotating Taste of KFC value menu where several items, such as 2 piece drums, 8 piece nuggets, or a Famous Bowl, are priced at around $5.00 each. The exact lineup changes over time.
Most KFC locations in the United States do not serve a breakfast menu. Breakfast is more common at KFC locations in other countries, so check your local restaurant.
KFC sides include Mac & Cheese, Mashed Potatoes & Gravy, Secret Recipe Fries, Cole Slaw, Sweet Corn, Green Beans and buttermilk biscuits. Individual sides start around $1.49 to $3.79.

faqs.q: What is the cheapest item at KFC?
faqs.a: The Chicken Little sandwich is one of the cheapest items at around $2.49, along with a single biscuit at about $1.79. The Taste of KFC $5 deals are the best value for a full snack.
